title: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Farmers for Purchasing Sanedo Agricultural Equipment

scheme.name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Farmers for Purchasing Sanedo Agricultural Equipment
scheme.summary: The scheme aims to support farmers by providing financial assistance for purchasing Sanedo agricultural equipment to reduce labor shortage and farming efforts.
eligibility: The applicant must be a landholding farmer.
The applicant must belong to the Gujarat state.
scheme.benefits: Assistance of 25% or 25,000/- of total cost whichever is less, once in 10 years.
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online through the I-Khedut Portal.

summary.value: The scheme aims to support farmers by providing financial assistance for purchasing Sanedo agricultural equipment to reduce labor shortage and farming efforts.
summary.quote: The "Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Farmers for Purchasing Sanedo Agricultural Equipment" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to support farmers by providing financial assistance to farmers for purchasing Sanedo (Mini Tractor) equipment.

eligibility.value: The applicant must be a landholding farmer.

benefits.quote: Assistance of 25 % or ₹25,000/- of total cost whichever is less; (Ride on Type Self Propelled Tool Bar) (Sanedo) or (Ride on Type Self Propelled Multipurpose Tool Bar)(Sanedo) tested by the Government of India approved testing centre and which has valid test report. once in 10 (ten) years
